packageRules.description: Flyway is pinned to 9.22.3 because org.valuereporter:valuereporter is published as a jar-with-dependencies that bundles Flyway 9.22.3. A newer Flyway here ends up merged with that copy in the shaded uber-jar, and the service dies at startup with 'IncompatibleClassChangeError: class org.flywaydb.core.api.CoreErrorCode can not implement org.flywaydb.core.api.ErrorCode'. This broke prod in 2.31.14 (Aug 2026). Re-enable once Valuereporter stops publishing a fat main artifact.
